_comment: Marker details file for ArUco backdrop calibration

_explanation.marker_size_cm: Physical size of printed ArUco markers in cm
_explanation.marker_positions_cm: Physical positions of marker centers in cm from floor
_explanation.scenario: Backdrop markings show 10cm and 200cm, but backdrop is 10cm off the ground
_explanation.calculation: Actual heights from floor = backdrop marking + 10cm elevation
_explanation.horizontal: x values represent horizontal position in cm (0cm = left edge)
